title: An-Nudjuh ar-Raqmi: Athar Qadamak, Qararuk (13-15 Years)
description: A pathway to help the teenager build a responsible digital footprint: understanding algorithms, interacting with artificial intelligence, balancing gaming, and protecting their digital reputation for the future.

primary_reference.info: منظمة الصحة العالمية: إرشادات إدمان الألعاب + اليونسكو: مواطنة رقمية

review_defects.arabic: النضج الرقمي: أثر قدمك، قرارك (13-15 سنة)
review_defects.english: An-Nudjuh ar-Raqmi: Athar Qadamak, Qararuk (13-15 Years)
review_defects.why: The Arabic title is meaningful ('Digital Maturity: Your Footprint, Your Decision'), but the English title is a mere transliteration, conveying no meaning to an English reader.
